title: Glutamine Synthetase 1 Functions in Spermatogenesis in the Silkworm, Bombyx mori.
authors: Fan, Zelin; Zhang, Lulu; Zhang, Surui; Zhang, Jiayin; Fang, Cuiqi; Lu, Xiuping; Zha, Xingfu
one_liner_zh: 该文研究家蚕谷氨酰胺合成酶BmGS1在精子发生中的功能，虽涉及转录因子Bmdsx调控和分子对接/MD模拟，但核心是酶功能与抑制剂筛选，非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，仅方法部分可借鉴。
abstract: Glutamine synthetase, a critical enzyme catalyzing the conversion of glutamate and ammonia into glutamine, has been shown to influence sperm development in mammals. Here, we carried out functional analysis of Bombyx mori homolog of glutamine synthetase 1 (BmGS1) and screened its small-molecule inhibitor. RT-PCR and qPCR showed that BmGS1 was specifically expressed in the testis of the silkworm, with the highest expression in the moth stage. Subcellular localization revealed that the BmGS1 protein was localized in mitochondria and cytoplasm. Identification of upstream regulatory factors revealed that the expression of BmGS1 is positively regulated by the sex-related transcription factor Bmdsx. Virtual screening, molecular docking and MD simulations showed that the small molecule Ethylhexyl triazone (ET), as well as the known GS inhibitor L-Methionine -DL-sulfoximine (MSX), could be stably bound to BmGS1. Subsequently, site-specific mutation and fluorescence binding assays revealed that the putative key sites of ET binding to the protein were E79 and R265, and the putative key sites of MSX binding to the protein were E81, R245, and R286. Both in vitro and in vivo experiments demonstrated that inhibitor treatment significantly attenuated BmGS1 enzymatic activity. Inhibitor-injected silkworms showed reduced fertilization rates compared to control groups. Our findings raise BmGS1 as a potential target for silkworm sterility.
abstract_zh: 谷氨酰胺合成酶是一种催化谷氨酸和氨转化为谷氨酰胺的关键酶，已被证明能影响哺乳动物的精子发育。在此，我们对家蚕谷氨酰胺合成酶1（BmGS1）的同源物进行了功能分析，并筛选了其小分子抑制剂。RT-PCR和qPCR结果显示，BmGS1在家蚕睾丸中特异性表达，且在蛾期表达量最高。亚细胞定位表明，BmGS1蛋白定位于线粒体和细胞质中。上游调控因子的鉴定显示，BmGS1的表达受性别相关转录因子Bmdsx的正向调控。虚拟筛选、分子对接和分子动力学（MD）模拟表明，小分子乙基己基三嗪酮（ET）以及已知的GS抑制剂L-甲硫氨酸-DL-亚砜亚胺（MSX）能稳定结合BmGS1。随后，位点特异性突变和荧光结合实验揭示，ET与蛋白结合的推定关键位点为E79和R265，而MSX与蛋白结合的推定关键位点为E81、R245和R286。体外和体内实验均表明，抑制剂处理显著降低了BmGS1的酶活性。与对照组相比，注射抑制剂的家蚕受精率降低。我们的研究结果将BmGS1定位为家蚕不育的潜在靶点。
